# Math dashboard visual regression fixtures

`zh-CN-dashboard-export.png` is the reviewed full-dashboard PNG baseline for Simplified Chinese export presentation. It covers the header, KPI grid, management table, four chart panels, confidence interval, risk section, reconciliation table, comparison section, and localized footer metadata.

When the fixture is intentionally regenerated, review it at native resolution for missing glyphs, clipped or wrapped text, chart-label legibility, table overflow, pale annotations, deprecated terminology, accidental English or Portuguese presentation text, and visible interactive language controls. Machine-facing identifiers, `RTP`, `Scatter`, and mathematical bucket notation remain intentionally invariant.
